heading: Opinion as to [2][electronic signature], when relevant.
text: When the Court has to form an opinion as to the [2][electronic signature of any person, the opinion of the Certifying Authority which has issued the [3][electronic Signature Certificate] is a relevant fact.]
status_note: The Act is repealed. Kept in India Code's 'Repeal Acts' collection; record title reads 'The Indian Evidence Act, 1872, 1 of 1872 (Rep., Act 47 of 2023)' (read 2026-11-21)
